_about: Which of the app's tools the assistant can use. Every tool id of src/lib/toolItems.ts and the ToolId of src/lib/tools.ts must be in `tools` (id -> the assistant tool that does it) or in `excluded` (id -> why not), and `registry` is the assistant's whole tool list; vitest (aiCoverage.test.ts) and a Rust test (ai/actions/tests.rs) keep all three in step. Commands that move data in or out (ids ending -import or -export), the forms layout operations and the custom stamps manager are listed the same way. Add a tool to the app: add it here.

excluded.protect: Sets a password the user must choose and keep: the assistant opens the tool (open_tool) and the user types it.
excluded.security: Permissions and encryption settings are the user's decision and need their password: the assistant only opens the tool (open_tool).
excluded.merge: Combining picks other files from disk, and the assistant never handles file paths: the assistant opens the tool (open_tool).
excluded.search-advanced: Searches a folder or files the user picks, which the assistant has no access to: the assistant opens the tool (open_tool); it can search this document with the search tool.
excluded.sign: A digital signature uses the user's own Digital ID and certificate: never the assistant's to apply.
excluded.certify: Certifying a document uses the user's own Digital ID: never the assistant's to apply.
excluded.sign-digital: A digital signature uses the user's own Digital ID and certificate: never the assistant's to apply.
excluded.fill-sign: Fill & Sign places the user's own saved signature and initials, typed or drawn by them: never the assistant's to add.
excluded.signatures: The Signatures panel shows whether the document's signatures are valid, for the user to inspect; the assistant does not judge or change them.
excluded.print: Printing sends the document to a device and is the user's decision.
excluded.overwrite-original: Assistant output never overwrites a file: new files get a free name next to the original and the user saves over it themselves.
excluded.open-link: Opening a link from a document is the user's decision.
excluded.picture-marks: A picture watermark, background or stamp needs an image file chosen by the user, and the assistant never handles file paths.
excluded.insert-image: Inserting an image needs a file chosen by the user, and the assistant never handles file paths.
excluded.measure: Measuring means clicking points along a drawing and confirming its scale, which is the user's to do on the page.
excluded.action-wizard: Runs a saved sequence of tools over files the user picks, and the assistant never handles file paths.
excluded.comments-export: Writes a data file (XFDF or FDF) the user names in a save dialog, and the assistant never handles file paths.
excluded.comments-import: Adds comments from a file the user picks, and the assistant never handles file paths. An import that replaces what the document holds would be destructive: the user's decision.
excluded.forms-export: Writes form data (FDF, XFDF, JSON, CSV, tab-delimited text or XML) to a file the user names in a save dialog, and the assistant never handles file paths.
excluded.forms-import: Overwrites form values from a file the user picks, and the assistant never handles file paths. Replacing the values a form holds is destructive: the user's decision.
excluded.forms-layout: Aligning, distributing, sizing, duplicating and renaming form fields is visual authoring in the Forms panel, field by field; the assistant fills fields and does not lay a form out.
excluded.custom-stamps: Opens the manager of the user's own stamp pictures, which are picked from files; the assistant never handles file paths, and a stamp is placed by clicking a spot on the page.
excluded.links: Editing links is a per-link decision in the page view, and Remove All Links deletes every link in the document in one go (destructive): the user's decision. The assistant opens the tool for the user (open_tool).
excluded.bookmarks: Editing bookmarks is done on the outline in the page view; the assistant opens the tool for the user (open_tool).
excluded.articles: Article threads are drawn by hand on the page; the assistant opens the tool for the user (open_tool).
excluded.output-preview: A prepress preview of separations and ink limits that the user inspects by eye; the assistant opens the tool for the user (open_tool).
excluded.convert-colors: The colour profile and rendering intent are the print shop's settings, the user's to choose; the assistant opens the tool for the user (open_tool).
excluded.printer-marks: Crop, bleed and registration marks depend on the press the user prints on; the assistant opens the tool for the user (open_tool).
excluded.page-boxes: Trim, bleed and art boxes are set to the user's print job; the assistant opens the tool for the user (open_tool).
excluded.create-portfolio: A portfolio combines files the user picks from disk and the assistant never handles file paths; the assistant opens the tool for the user (open_tool).
excluded.doc-javascript: Document JavaScript runs code inside the file whenever it is opened: never the assistant's to add or change.
